oracle_design: Q09 asserts exact scalar cardinality/finite positive width and retained cost, preserved input statistics, public consumer conversion, Intermediate/dedup/grouped controls and missing-prerequisite guards. Zero metadata column counts are local boundary robustness fixtures, not claims of fully typed physical plans.

Q20 uses independent named alias/spec expectations and direct expected numeric input modifications; the existing production CBO estimator is the cost-model oracle. No private alias helper or statistics-method implementation is copied or extracted.

Q20 checks metadata output aliases separately from both-input hint aliases. Semi/anti matching includes the hidden input while output metadata excludes it. Self-join suffixing retains existing source policy.

Multiplicative hints exercise side routing and repeated-computation idempotence. Composite Applied flags and unmatched flags are observed; side ApplyRowsHints/ApplyBytesHints copy hints, so persistent Applied is not claimed as a side-consumption counter.

Existing OA06 receipt binding covers baseline/fixed source and exact ordered vectors. Passing records require reviewed assertion counts. Baseline controls must pass before paired local improvement is accepted.
The SQL quality gate always requires fixed direct evidence for Q09/Q20. Local admission never proves query semantics or full optimization quality.
remaining: Compile/link and actual guarded baseline/fixed local execution
